role: later independent, post-confirmatory four-class cross-day validation
source: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.18988317, repackaged from IEEE DataPort 10.21227/f1c7-7x89; original study 10.3389/fnhum.2021.701091
subjects: all 20 public subjects; no performance-based exclusions
source_session: session_1, all six runs; run-group cross-validation for model duration selection
target_session: session_2, all six runs, evaluated once after source-only selection lock; sessions_3 through 7 not used in this audit
channels: the 26 EEG channels common to both hardware groups; determine the 41-channel group's exact indices from source metadata or original montage using session_1 only, record a prespecified mapping addendum before session_2 extraction; fail closed if mapping cannot be verified
epoch: class-event relative [0,4) seconds of the 5-second imagery interval; verify event order and cue-to-class timing using session_1 only before target access; downsample 500 to 250 Hz with anti-alias filtering
signal_processing: retain acquisition 0.5-100 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch; no additional bandpass, artifact rejection, or target-level fitting; use source signal microvolt units after verification
architecture_and_optimization: same frozen OpenBMI recipe except channels=26, classes=4 and data paths; adapt temporal input length only if required, document before target access
selection: two-fold leave-three-session_1-runs-out validation; selected epoch is rounded median of fold optima, then fresh session_1 retraining
primary_contrast: subject-macro session_2 accuracy, RD minus NoDemean
secondary_contrast: RD minus EEGNet-Demean; balanced accuracy and per-class recall descriptive
inferential_unit: subject; average seeds within each subject before paired contrasts
uncertainty: paired subject bootstrap 100000 draws, fixed seed 20260927; exact subject sign-flip permutation if feasible (2^20), otherwise deterministic Monte Carlo 1000000 flips
release_gate: hash source archives, preprocessing code, processed session_1 arrays, configs and all selected epochs before extracting any session_2 epochs or evaluating target outcomes
interpretation: rest is an idle class; this is a later locked external audit, not a new prospective confirmation of the original OpenBMI hypothesis
